confidence_basis: Reference layers from one optical scene, one agency layer and two automated optical methods; no ground check.
assumptions: Each reference is the layer an earlier work package recorded, read unchanged and checked against the SHA-256 and the counts of the record that binds it.
A 20 m cell takes part in tuning only where the rule of its set gives water (1) or dry (0); every other cell is 255 and takes no part.
Sukhothai: a 2 m pixel holds a value when the frozen rule v2 gave it 0 or 1; 255 (cloud) and pixels outside the chip hold none.
Mae Sai: the rule given for the set is silent on 20 m cells of which only one of four 10 m cells was compared; this lane leaves them out, by the half rule the other two sets use, and counts them.
Mae Sai: where the agency mapped no water the cell counts as dry, as in the dated radar check; the layer has no 'not observed' class.
Chaiyaphum: code 2 records water on both optical dates, not independently established permanent water, and is not compared.
No radar map is set against any reference here: the counts describe the references only.
what_this_is: The recorded reference of each tuning area of the Nan case on that area's 20 m grid, built before the method is tuned. Counts of reference cells only; no radar map is set against them here.
label: Reference layers for tuning. Agreement of a radar map with them is agreement with a reference, not accuracy.

sukhothai_chip.protocol_reference: the frozen THEOS-2 water rule v2 on the Sukhothai chip: a 20 m cell is water when at least half of its 2 m pixels are water, not compared when fewer than half of them hold a value
sukhothai_chip.rule: A 20 m cell is water when at least half of its 2 m pixels (50 of 100) are water under the frozen THEOS-2 water rule v2; dry when at least half hold a value (0 or 1) and fewer than half are water; not compared when fewer than half hold a value or the cell centre lies outside the chip rectangle (valid_rectangle_epsg32647 of the cross-check reference record). Pixels outside the chip hold no value.

mae_sai_20241022.rule: A 10 m cell is compared where the dated radar check of work package 3 compared it: inside Mae Sai district (COD-AB tha_admin3 units with adm2_pcode TH5709), outside ESA WorldCover permanent water, with a valid radar value after. firewall: No file of the Nan frame was opened: not the sealed JAXA folder, not any GFM file, not the THEOS-2 files of 31 July 2025 nor anything derived from them. Every path was checked against that list before it was opened.
limits: The references are not ground observations: an optical rule at Sukhothai, an agency layer at Mae Sai that was not checked in the field, and two automated optical methods at Chaiyaphum.
Sukhothai and Mae Sai were seen as development data before this case (R37); Chaiyaphum's optical reference was used once for the optical v2 test.
Any figure computed against these layers is agreement with a reference, not accuracy. Planning guidance only.
